description: Book the client a NEW appointment with a pro (id or booking handle from find_pros_to_book) at an open time from pro_open_times. Confirm the details with the client first. Needs a confirmed mobile number (verify_my_phone). To CHANGE an existing booking, never book a second one: use reschedule_my_booking. The client gets a text confirmation with a link to view, reschedule or cancel.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "tomorrow", in the pro's time zone.

name.description: Name for the booking. Defaults to the client's ShearQuery name.

time.description: e.g. "3pm", exactly as pro_open_times listed it.

name: book_with_pro
title: Book an appointment with a barber or stylist
